final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(f.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - s.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_second FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN second_average s WHERE f.ratio > s.avg_ratio
